news.title: CUBE Entrusted to Formulate "Sustainable Mining Policy" for Tamil Nadu
news.summary: CUBE has been entrusted to formulate the comprehensive "Sustainable Mining Policy" and scientific guidelines for the Government of Tamil Nadu.
content: The Centre for Urbanization, Buildings & Environment (CUBE) at IIT Madras Research Park has been officially entrusted with formulating the Sustainable Mining Policy.
The policy provides an objective scientific framework balancing mineral extraction, environmental conservation, and local community safeguards.

news.title: CUBE Signs Strategic MOU with Engineering Projects India Limited (EPIL)
news.summary: CUBE formalizes MoU with EPIL for joint execution of advanced engineering, infrastructure development, and quality assurance.
content: CUBE signed an official Memorandum of Understanding with Engineering Projects India Limited (EPIL) to collaborate on high-stakes urban infrastructure and quality assurance.
The pact leverages IIT Madras faculty expertise to support national and state engineering consultancy assignments.

news.title: CUBE Expert Team Visits Villupuram Government Medical College Hospital
news.summary: Senior structural specialists from CUBE conducted on-site structural condition assessment and non-destructive evaluation at Villupuram Govt Medical College.
content: A multidisciplinary expert team from CUBE visited the Villupuram Government Medical College Hospital for on-site structural health monitoring.
Using non-destructive testing (NDT), ultrasonic pulse velocity, and rebound hammer testing, the team evaluated building durability and submitted retrofit recommendations.

news.title: Preparation of DPR for Restoration & Refurbishment of Historic Gokhale Hall
news.summary: CUBE technical division prepared the Detailed Project Report (DPR) for the heritage conservation and structural refurbishment of Gokhale Hall, Chennai.
content: CUBE's Urban Planning & Transportation team delivered the DPR for the comprehensive conservation and structural refurbishment of the historic Gokhale Hall in Chennai.
The project combines architectural heritage restoration with modern structural retrofitting.

projects.description: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs(MoHUA) initiated a Global Housing Technology Challenge to identify the best available construction technologies from across the globe. Out of the identified 54 technologies, Six Light House Projects using six distinct technologies were finalised. The Honble Prime Minister laid the foundation stone of Six Light House Projects on 1st January 2021. Through a competitive bidding process, IIT Madras has been appointed by the Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs to provide Third Party Quality Assurance Services for their flagship project of constructing affordable housing using innovating and new technologies approved by Building Materials And Technology Promotion Council [BMTPC]. The following six projects with different technologies at each project site are being undertaken: 1. Indore, Madhya Pradesh1,024 (S+8) - Prefabricated Sandwich Panel System 2. Rajkot, Gujarat1,144 (S+13) - Monolithic Concrete Construction using Tunnel Formwork 3. Chennai, Tamil Nadu1,152 (G+5) - Precast Concrete Construction System Precast Components Assembled at Site 4. Ranchi, Jharkhand1,008 (G+8) - Precast Concrete Construction System 3D Volumetric 5. Agartala, Tripura1,000 (G+6) - Light Gauge Steel Structural System & Pre-engineered Steel Structural System 6. Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh1,040 (S+13) - PVC Stay In Place Formwork System

careers.description: Lead independent third-party structural inspection, concrete durability testing, and design verification for government affordable housing and institutional projects.
qualifications: M.Tech / B.Tech in Structural / Civil Engineering from reputed institute
Deep expertise in IS 456, IS 1893, IS 13920 and non-destructive testing (NDT)
Experience in proof checking and site quality monitoring

careers.title: Environmental Engineer & Hydrologist
careers.experience: 3-6 Years in Hydrodynamic Modeling & Water Quality
careers.description: Conduct 2D flood simulations, STP/ETP design reviews, water balance audits, and lake rejuvenation feasibility studies across Tamil Nadu river basins.
qualifications: Master’s degree in Environmental Engineering / Water Resources
Proficiency in HEC-RAS, GIS, and hydrodynamic software packages
Laboratory testing acquaintance with CEL protocols

tenders.title: Procurement of Inductively Coupled Plasma Mass Spectrometer (ICP-MS) for CEL Laboratory
tenders.description: Notice Inviting Tender for supply, installation, testing and commissioning of advanced elemental analysis instrument at CUBE Environmental Laboratory.

tenders.title: Expression of Interest for Specialized Ultrasonic Pulse Velocity (UPV) Testing Services
tenders.description: Empanelment of specialized testing agencies for statewide bridge structural health monitoring.

celServices.title: Water Quality Testing
celServices.description: Comprehensive physical, chemical, and biological testing for drinking water, surface water, and groundwater in accordance with IS 10500 standards.
parameters: Heavy Metals (Pb, Cd, As, Cr, Hg, Ni)

celServices.title: Wastewater & Effluent Characterization
celServices.description: Performance evaluation and regulatory compliance monitoring for municipal STPs, industrial ETPs, and common effluent treatment plants (CETP).

celServices.title: Solid Waste & Sludge Diagnostics
celServices.description: Physical-chemical characterization of municipal solid waste, compost quality testing, and hazardous industrial sludge profiling.
parameters: Moisture Content, Volatile Organic Matter, Ash Content

celServices.title: Specialized Environmental Diagnostics
celServices.description: Advanced investigative studies for microplastics, organic micropollutants, industrial brine recovery, and soil contamination remediation.
parameters: Soil permeability and cation exchange capacity

teamMembers.name: Prof. V. Kamakoti
teamMembers.bio: Prof. V. Kamakoti is the Director of IIT Madras and serves as the Chairman of CUBE. A renowned academician and leader in computer science and technology policy, he guides CUBE's strategic mission of delivering world-class engineering solutions for sustainable urbanization.

teamMembers.name: L. PADMANABAN(Major General [Retired])
teamMembers.bio: Leading CUBE's operational verticals, project management consultancy, and industrial partnerships, bridging public governance with cutting-edge academic expertise.
